english.notes:
(i) Statutory requirement for corroboration (section 13).
(ii) No prosecution for knowingly and wilfully making a false declaration for the purpose of procuring any marriage out of the district in which the parties or one of them dwell shall take place after the expiration of eighteen months from the solemnisation of the marriage to which the declaration refers - (section 3(2) of the Perjury Act 1911).
(iii) For offences which occur before 4th May 2021, see H5366.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Seven years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None but see note (ii) above.

Note
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
